issue_context.title: Documentation improvement on tiktoken integration
issue_context.body:
I want to load tokenizers from tiktoken to use for model training. Right now, this page https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/tiktoken is only info I could find on tiktoken integration.

Following the instructions on the page, I just need to add a `tokenizer.model` to model directory. In light of this, I have a few questions:
1. How do I generate this file from tiktoken's Encoding class?
2. What happens when I save the model? Does it get converted to HF format or is it saved as tiktoken tokenizer?

Would appreciate any help on this!
comments:
So here is what I am going with:
```python
from pathlib import Path

import tiktoken
from tiktoken.load import dump_tiktoken_bpe
from transformers.convert_slow_tokenizer import TikTokenConverter

from transformers.tokenization_utils_fast import TIKTOKEN_VOCAB_FILE


def preload_tiktoken(tokenizer_name: str, output_dir: str | Path):
    output_dir = Path(output_dir)
    output_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    save_file = output_dir / 'tiktoken' / TIKTOKEN_VOCAB_FILE

    encoding = tiktoken.get_encoding(tokenizer_name)
    dump_tiktoken_bpe(encoding._mergeable_ranks, save_file)

    TikTokenConverter(
        vocab_file=save_file, 
        pattern=encoding._pat_str, 
        additional_special_tokens=encoding._special_tokens
    ).tokenizer().save(output_dir)
```

As far as I know, there is no way to change the pattern string without directly using the `TiktokenConverter`. If someone can verify if this is the intended approach, please let me know!

UPD: Well, now I have `tokenizer.json` file and have no idea what to do with it..

Hey! Could you open a PR for this? 🤗 
The `tokenizer.json` file can now be used with `PreTrainedTokenizerFast.from_pretrained("path_to_folder")` which is the `transformers` format!

We can also add your function as a util to convert from an encoding / directly from tiktoken encoding name!

This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. If you think this still needs to be addressed please comment on this thread.

Please note that issues that do not follow the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) are likely to be ignored.

review_comments:
To actually work, the tokenizer pipeline needs the ByteLevel and Split pre-tokenizers (with the pattern string), the ByteLevel post-processor, and the special tokens from the original encoding. It looks like the `.converted()` method on the original TikTokenConverter adds these already: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/98e8062df3cf82b367e8a243963e4afb0d9d3407/src/transformers/convert_slow_tokenizer.py#L1532

but the `convert_tiktoken_to_fast` wrapper just uses the `.tokenizer()` method, which saves only the actual merges. This isn't documented, so unless you read the source code and/or inspect the actual tokenizers file, you won't realize the full pipeline is incomplete until Unicode tokens or special tokens start breaking.

This took me a couple hours to figure out what went wrong (porting the Fish Speech 1.5 tokenizer from Tiktoken). Is there a reason `convert_tiktoken_to_fast` doesn't just use the `.converted()` method? If this isn't possible, could the docs at least explicitly call out what the remaining steps are to set up the BPE pipeline?
Sorry about that, you are right! pushing a fix
